articles.title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
articles.description:
The city is giving residents an extra week to pitch projects for the latest round of participatory budgeting.

The post It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Boston extends deadline for participatory budgeting project submissions by one week.
Residents can pitch ideas for a total of $2 million in city spending.
Participation empowers locals to influence community projects and improvements directly.

articles.title: Trump blasts Pirro after she refutes his claim that Reflecting Pool was damaged by vandals
articles.description:
The president, without providing any clear new evidence, continued to allege on Saturday that the majority of the damage to the pool was caused by vandals.

The post Trump blasts Pirro after she refutes his claim that Reflecting Pool was damaged by vandals appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Trump claims Reflecting Pool damage primarily caused by vandals, without new evidence.
Judge Jeanine Pirro publicly refutes Trump's vandalism claim on August 2, 2026.
Local residents may question the integrity of public statements regarding national monuments.
